title: TestRequest
description: Which throwaway copy of the code to test, which test files to run there, and how long the run may take. The run may write inside the copy and nowhere else.

folder.description: A throwaway copy of the code that the caller made for this call and will remove afterwards; never a worktree a builder works in. It is inside the project, and given relative to it or in full. The toolchain's tools may write inside it, such as a build output or a cache, and write nothing outside it. A verdict is about the code as the caller gave it, so a second call on the same folder gives the same verdicts.

items.description: A test file, relative to the checkout; it cannot leave the checkout or start with a dash.

files.description: The test files to run; left out, every test runs.

timeLimitSeconds.description: How long the run may take before it is stopped and its verdict is inconclusive; left out, the toolchain's own limit applies. A whole suite may need up to 1000 seconds: the kit's own takes about 450 alone and longer beside another run.
